definitions.gloss: pluck; combativeness; readiness to take someone on
definitions.explanation: A disposition to face an opponent or difficulty head-on rather than backing down. Carries a note of youthful boldness that can shade into recklessness, and is most often used of someone who is outmatched but refuses to yield.

examples.english: He is a scrappy sort who never backs down.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{向|む}こう{気|き}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{強|つよ}かった→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: When I was young I was all fight and no sense.

examples.japanese: {向|む}こう{気|き}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強|つよ}さ→強さ：25692_tsuyosa⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝|か}てる→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧ほど⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: This is not a world where sheer combativeness alone is enough to win.

notes:
Almost always appears with ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ — the bare noun is rarely used on its own. The evaluation is mixed: admiring of the courage, wary of the lack of judgment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {向|む}こう{気|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: to be plucky; to never back down
- {向|む}こう{気|き}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: a combative temperament
- {向|む}こう{気|き}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人一倍|ひといちばい}: to have more fight in one than anybody

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{負|ま}けん{気|き}→負けん気：30763_makenki⟧: competitive spirit — hating to lose, without the sense of squaring up to an opponent
- ⟦{気|き}が{強|つよ}い→気が強い：30270_kigatsuyoi⟧: strong-willed — general assertiveness, not tied to confrontation
- {血気|けっき}: hot-bloodedness — more literary, emphasizes youthful impetuousness
